states.eval: document.querySelectorAll('#dc-root [data-bp]').forEach(e => { const t = e.getAttribute('data-bp'); if (!['bar', 'mission'].includes(t)) e.remove(); }); document.querySelectorAll('#dc-root [data-bp="mission"]').forEach(r => { r.querySelectorAll(':scope > div').forEach(d => d.remove()); r.querySelector('a').textContent = ''; });
